title: OMNIGUARD: An Efficient Approach for AI Safety Moderation Across Languages and Modalities
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a safety moderation classifier to detect harmful prompts (e.g., instructions on how to make a bomb) across various languages and modalities. While it includes a brief 'Ethics' section discussing the risks of model deployment, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, theology, morals, or specific ethical frameworks.
